select: select a.id, a.name, a.parent_id, a.employ_id, a.status, a.userid, a.email, a.mobile, a.gender, a.department, a.`position`, a.entry_date, a.leaving_date, a.region_code, a.area_code, a.factory_code, a.is_admin, a.is_reset, a.status, a.parent_id, a.factory_m_role from jml_staff a where a.id = #{staffId}

select a.id, a.name, a.parent_id, a.employ_id, a.status, a.userid, a.email, a.mobile, a.gender, a.department, a.`position`, a.entry_date, a.leaving_date, a.region_code, a.area_code from jml_staff a where a.employ_id = #{staffCode}
sql: with recursive staff_tree as ( select aa.* from jml_staff aa where aa.id = #{staffId} and aa.status = '1' union all select bb.* from jml_staff bb join staff_tree cc on bb.parent_id = cc.id where bb.status = '1' ) select a.id, a.name, a.area_code, a.region_code, a.parent_id from staff_tree a

choose.when: select a.id, a.name, a.area_code, a.region_code, a.parent_id from jml_staff a where a.status = '1'

when.test: staff.roleRM == true || staff.roleSA == true || staff.roleSD == true

choose.when: select a.id, a.name, a.area_code, a.region_code, a.parent_id from jml_staff a where a.status = '1' and exists( select rt.id, rt.staff_id, rt.area_id, rt.area_code from jml_staff_area rt left join jml_staff_area rt1 on rt1.area_code = rt.area_code where rt1.staff_id = #{staffId} and rt.staff_id = a.id and rt.enable = '1' )

select:
select a.id, a.name, a.area_code, a.region_code, a.parent_id from jml_staff a where a.status = '1'
where a.id != #{staffId}
select id, name, area_code, region_code, parent_id, employ_id, status, userid, email, mobile, gender, department, `position`, avatar from jml_staff a where a.userid = #{userid}

SELECT a.name, a.id, a.userid, a.avatar, b.role_name FROM jml_staff AS a LEFT JOIN jml_staff_role AS b ON a.id = b.staff_id and b.enable = '1' LEFT JOIN jml_role AS c ON c.id = b.role_id
a.status = '1' and (c.role_code IN ('GM', 'SD', 'RM','SA') OR a.id = #{ownerStaffId})
and a.name LIKE '${staffName}%'
ORDER BY CONVERT(a.name USING gbk) COLLATE gbk_chinese_ci;

select id, name, area_code, region_code, parent_id, employ_id, status, userid, email, mobile, gender, department, `position`, avatar, openid, unionid, is_admin, factory_m_role from jml_staff where mobile = #{mobile} and pwd = #{pwd} and status = '1'

select a.id, a.name, a.mobile from jml_staff a left join jml_staff_role b on b.staff_id = a.id left join jml_role c on c.id = b.role_id where a.`status` = '1' and b.`enable` = '1' and c.role_code = 'FAC'
SELECT b.id, b.name, b.mobile from jml_staff a left join jml_staff b on a.parent_id = b.id WHERE a.id = #{staff.staffId}
